'''2013 Alderaan Regionals Ryan Jellison LS Hidden Base (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ryan Jellison]] at [[2013 Alderaan Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hidden Base (V) / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers (V)]]
* '''Username:''' sac89837
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
